complianceChecks.name: General System Size Applicability
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: The population equivalent (EW\_{BSB5}) connected to the system.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: ≤ 5000 E (Size Class 2).
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: The system falls within the regulatory scope of this specific DWA-A 201 standard.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: The standard no longer applies for biological sizing, meaning more stringent regulations or different technological approaches for larger facilities must be used (except for *Schönungsteiche* which are open-ended).
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Re-evaluate the catchment area or split the treatment streams.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Mandatory for all primary treatment ponds.

complianceChecks.name: General Construction Geometries
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Pond geometry (slope incline, length-to-width ratio, and minimum depth/freeboard).
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * Böschungsneigung (Slope): ≤ 1:2 for natural soil, ≤ 1:3 for clay seals. * Length to width: ≥ 3:1. * Tiefe (Depth) for settling zone: ≥ 1,5 m. * Freibord (Freeboard): 0,3 m.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Geometry is accepted as structurally stable and hydraulically sound.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: Must be redesigned to avoid short-circuiting flows or slope collapses.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Adjust the length, width, or depth parameters in the design layout.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Mandatory for all pond projects.

complianceChecks.name: Soil Permeability / Need for Artificial Sealing (Wasserdichtheit)
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Soil permeability coefficient (k\_f) in the lowest 0.3 m of the soil profile.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * General ponds: k\_f \< 10^{-8} m/s allows natural soil. * Polishing ponds (Schönungsteiche): k\_f \< 10^{-7} m/s allows natural soil.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES (permeability is lower than the threshold): The natural soil acts as the seal. No artificial liner is required.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS (permeability is ≥ 10^{-8} m/s or soil is fractured): Artificial sealing is mandatory. Must install plastic sheets (≥ 3 mm and UV-resistant), concrete, asphalt, bentonite, or a ≥ 30 cm thick compacted clay/bentonite layer (≥ 95% Proctor density),.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: If a soft artificial seal is required, the designer must check if desludging vehicles can still enter (or switch to floating pumps).
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Mandatory check for all projects.

complianceChecks.name: Primary Settlement Ponds (Absetzteiche) Sizing
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Specific volume (V\_{EW}), retention time (t\_R), and maximum flow velocity.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * V\_{EW} ≥ 0,5 m^3/E (includes 0,15 m^3/E for sludge). * t\_R ≥ 1 d (at dry weather flow). * Velocity at the outlet baffle ≤ 0,05 m/s.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Pond sizing is sufficient for sludge digestion (cold digestion) and settling.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: The pond is undersized; poor settling or sludge washout will occur.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Increase the physical volume/area of the pond in the design phase.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Conditional (Only if Absetzteiche are used).

complianceChecks.name: Unaerated Ponds (Unbelüftete Teiche) Sizing
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Specific surface area (A\_{EW}).
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * Baseline: ≥ 10 m^2/E * With upstream settlement: ≥ 8 m^2/E * Treating stormwater without upstream relief: add + 5 m^2/E * For partial nitrification: ≥ 15 m^2/E * Depth: \sim 1,0 m
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Design area is sufficient for natural oxygen transfer and biological treatment.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: Redesign required to increase the pond footprint.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Expand the land footprint of the pond.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Conditional (Only if unaerated ponds are used).

complianceChecks.name: Aerated Ponds (Belüftete Teiche) Sizing
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Volumetric loading rate (B\_{R,BSB}), retention time (t\_R), oxygen supply, and power density (P\_R).
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * Volumetric loading: ≤ 25 g/(m^3· d) * Minimum retention time: t\_R ≥ 5 d * Oxygen transfer: OV\_{C,BSB} ≥ 1,5 kg O\_2 / kg BSB\_5 * Power density: P\_R \= 1 bis 3 W/m^3
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Volume and aeration capacity are sufficient.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: Risk of anaerobic conditions and odor. Pond volume or aerator size must be increased.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Adjust the pond volume or select stronger aeration equipment.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Conditional (Only if aerated ponds are used).

complianceChecks.name: Secondary Clarifiers (Nachklärteiche) Sizing
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Retention time (t\_R), depth, and surface area.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * t\_R ≥ 1 d calculated at Maximaldurchfluss (peak mixed inflow). * Minimum depth: ≥ 1,2 m. * Minimum area: 20 m^2.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Settling capacity is sufficient even during rain events.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: Pond volume must be increased.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Increase depth or footprint.
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Conditional (Only if Nachklärteiche are used).

complianceChecks.name: Operational Desludging Trigger (Unbelüftete Teiche)
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Sludge accumulation height.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: Sludge height reaches 1/4 of the original water depth.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES (below 1/4): Normal pond operation continues.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS (at or exceeds 1/4): Mandatory desludging is triggered to prevent performance loss.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Sludge is physically pumped/removed, resetting the volume, and operation resumes.

complianceChecks.name: Operational Desludging Trigger (Belüftete Teiche)
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: Remaining active water volume (and corresponding retention time).
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: Sludge accumulation causes the effective retention time to drop to \< 5 days per basin.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES (retention time ≥ 5 days): Normal operation continues.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS (retention time drops below threshold): Mandatory desludging is triggered.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Sludge is removed, restoring the 5-day minimum volume.

complianceChecks.name: Operational Water Depth Clearance Over Sludge
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: The minimum clear water depth resting directly above the sludge layer.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: * ≥ 1,0 m for Absetzteiche (Settling ponds). * ≥ 0,9 m for Nachklärteiche (Secondary clarifiers).
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: Settling functions correctly without washout.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: Sludge is too high; triggers immediate desludging.

complianceChecks.name: Sludge Screen Requirement for Land Application
complianceChecks.whatChecked: What value is being checked: The physical gap size (Stababstand) of the mechanical screen used during sludge extraction.
complianceChecks.criterion: Exact threshold or criterion: Stababstand ≤ 10 mm.
complianceChecks.passOutcome: If PASSES: The sludge is cleared of plastics/hygiene articles and is legally permissible for agricultural utilization.
complianceChecks.failOutcome: If FAILS: The sludge contains macro-plastics and is prohibited from being spread on agricultural land.
complianceChecks.iterationHint: Iteration loop: Must change the screen to a finer mesh or change the disposal route (e.g., incineration).
complianceChecks.conditional: Mandatory/Conditional: Conditional (Applies only if no screen was installed at the raw wastewater inlet AND the sludge is destined for agriculture).
